composition_subtypes.role: Sort elements by value to group identical values together
Greedily assign colors in round-robin fashion over sorted order

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort elements by value, then assign colors cyclically (1..k) to ensure each value appears ≤k times with distinct colors.
payload.rationale: Sorting groups identical values; the round-robin greedy assignment guarantees distinct colors for any value with frequency ≤k. Both mechanisms are essential.
